description: A global default and a local conditional declaration can share a feature when no earlier stage tests it (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%features f
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes = B
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
```
